answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 150674 Country: india Title: Video conference is allowed ? Question: I am working with MNC software company. My job is there as a desktop support engineer. We need daily basis ‘video conference’ testing to other location (Mumbai, Chennai, etc). check audio video quality and its working or not. So it is allowed in Islam? Answer ID: 150674 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 682/677/D=9/1438) There is no harm to check it through audio. However, since video involves a kind of picture making hence one should avoid it as much as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
